items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1958-04-04
items.q: One question I want to ask is that how long did you play with Papa, Paul Spaniel? About sixteen years.

ctx.x: Do you think that it's a good idea to make children learn musical instruments or do you think it's better to wait until they want to learn?

Yes. That's the best. When they want to learn. When they want to learn. What a feeling is getting. That's right. Yes. We don't want to bother here. In another five minutes maybe we'll be through. I want to keep you all day. I know. I've got the time and I've got the money. All this is very important really. Thank you. We certainly enjoy hearing this. I feel that a lot of young students that want to learn clarinet would like to hear you talk too. I know that you and not many people have the opportunity to come and…
